#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    std::string input, line;
    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        input += line + " ";
    }

    std::istringstream iss(input);
    int n;
    iss >> n;

    long long a[3], b[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) iss >> a[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) iss >> b[i];

    long long max = std::min(a[0], b[1]) + std::min(a[1], b[2]) + std::min(a[2], b[0]);
    long long min = std::max(0LL, a[0] + b[1] - n)
                  + std::max(0LL, a[1] + b[2] - n)
                  + std::max(0LL, a[2] + b[0] - n);

    std::cout << min << " " << max << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
